flags: Trail guide gives 136 miles; the state brochure gives a 112-mile loop plus a 25-mile spur, totaling 137. Retained the trail guide’s attributed mileage. Brochure driving time and archived FHWA enjoyment allowance describe different scopes and are omitted.
No account of byway organizers or construction of the whole circuit is cached. Road history focuses on the documented Warm Springs Road bridge and the later state/national designations.

All current moments and their metadata are retained, reordered west to east from Paw Paw via Berkeley Springs and the southern branch to Harpers Ferry. The intro completes the loop on the northern branch.

The trail’s Paw Paw page calls the 1836–1850 construction period fourteen years behind schedule, while Wikipedia documents an expected 1838 completion. Omitted the erroneous delay and immediate-obsolescence claim: both pages document boats continuing until 1924. Corrected six million bricks to more than six million.

Jefferson Rock pillar dates disagree: trail page says late nineteenth century; Wikipedia says 1855–1860. Omitted installation date. The bathtub is a reconstruction, not an authenticated surviving Washington bathing tub.

No current NPS access page is cached. The trail body supports the paths and views, but this draft does not verify daily access, tour schedules or temporary closures. Omitted the current draft’s presidential-monument superlative, which appears only as an uncorroborated claim in the trail’s promotional page.
